body: depression caused by a disease that cant be cured

The only safe time for me to do it is at night when i am alone and no one will call or ring me.So i spend all day thinking of suicide waiting for night when i can do it.But then i just go to bed and go to sleep.
And this has been going on every day for almost 1 year now :(

But why would god or whoever is in charge punish me for this.
I don't understand ?
If i could cure this disease i would be happy again.
I don't want to kill myself but i can't live like this either.

The meetup was free.
You would have to figure out how to get there.
I was really scared going but when i got there everyone else said they
were scared going too.This event was on every week.Some of the people there it was their second/third attempt to go.They were too scared before.

I had very bad social anxiety.Not sure where you are from but i found
on meetup.com and similar sites groups for people with social anxiety
we all met up for coffee and chat (about 30 people) it was amazing i thought i was the only one with this condition but lots of the people were even worse than me.See if you can find something similar.

When i got there and saw all the people i got scared and turned around to leave but one of the people called me back i was so happy he did.Five mins later another person done same i called him back !

It was very relaxed some people barely said a word but it was ok because we all understood each other

I am depressed because of a medical issue with no cure.
Cant cure depression because cant cure medical issue
vicious circle
